info.title: Family Hub API
info.description: Multi-tenant family-coordination API. This spec is generated from the live Hono route table (FHS-356) — every endpoint here is a real, mounted route.

kidAuth.description: Kid PIN session token from POST /api/auth/kid-pin.

post.summary: Exchange a kid PIN for a kid session token
Claim invites addressed to my email

get.summary: The kid's My World analytics (stats view)
The kid's schedule for a week (their own + family-wide)
The kid's active investments with live value (identical to parent GET /mw/financial/investments)
The kid's banked savings + currency (identical to parent GET /mw/financial/savings)
The kid's habits + stickers + balance (identical to parent GET /api/habits)
The kid's journal entry for a day (+ the day's quote)

post.summary: Grade one of the kid's answers

get.summary: Questions for the kid's lesson + their stats

parameters.name: subtopic
parameters.description: Logic sub-topic filter (patterns|odd-one-out|if-then|sorting). Logic only; ignored for other subjects.

post.summary: Generate an AI Maths lesson for the kid (feature-flagged)

200.description: { enabled: false } when the flag is off; { enabled: true, lesson } on success; { enabled: true, lesson: null, error } on AI failure

get.summary: Whether AI Maths lessons are enabled (cheap probe, no generation)
All earned maths certificates for this kid

200.description: Certificates in DB order; difficulty is the table number string or easy/medium/hard

post.summary: Award a certificate (idempotent — returns existing if already earned)

200.description: { certificate, alreadyEarned } — 200 if already earned, 201 if newly created

post.summary: Apply placement test results and auto-master qualifying tables

200.description: unlocked[] — the table numbers newly mastered by this call (already-mastered tables are excluded)

get.summary: All maths progress rows for this kid (all operations + tables)

200.description: Every (operation, table_number) row the kid has touched, in DB order

put.summary: Upsert one maths progress row — only supplied fields are updated

200.description: The upserted row after the update

get.summary: The kid's profile for the dashboard header (name, avatar, stars/cash)

post.summary: Add a book to the kid reading log

delete.summary: Remove a book from the kid reading log

get.summary: The kid's reward shop + star balance + their latest request status per reward

post.summary: The kid asks to redeem a reward (no deduction; an admin approves)

200.description: The pending request row (idempotent — returns an existing pending one)

get.summary: The kid's own habits for today
The kid's weeks (full shape, identical to parent GET /mw/weeks)
Audit log of week actions for one of the kid's weeks
Sticker counts + cash value for one of the kid's weeks

200.description: All country codes this kid has explored, in DB order

post.summary: Mark a country flag as explored (idempotent)

200.description: { explored: true } — always, even if already recorded

get.summary: The kid's world-flags learn progress per continent

200.description: Completed set indices per continent, each array sorted ascending

post.summary: Mark a learn-path set as mastered (idempotent)

200.description: { completed: true } — always, even if already recorded
The user and the tenants they belong to

put.summary: Set a kid member's login PIN

get.summary: A child's My World analytics (parent view)
A child's active investments with live value (?memberId=)

200.description: Each item carries `deductible` — false means missed days count but apply no penalty

post.summary: Toggle an active investment's deductible flag (FHS-378)

200.description: The updated investment row (404 if missing, 409 if not active)

post.summary: Approve a request — admin only; deducts star_cost from the kid's savings
Decline a request — admin only; no deduction

Check if a family URL slug is free
